page.layout: One page of text in a single column; decorative woodcut borders at left and right margins with marginal emblem fragments; a show-through mirrored inscription at the bottom (not transcribed). Running head at top; page number 130 at top left.

main_text.head: Fur extinƈto lumine penetrans in ades alienas.Peccatum bonam mentem auferens.
main_text.p: Auferat vt clausa nummos fur improbus aulâ, Illùc extincto lumine tentat iter.
Obstruat vt vitium veríque boníque saporem, Extinguit mentis lucida dona bonæ.
Quærere Pæonia properas solamen ab arte, Vt promptus linquat tempora presla dolor.
Pharmaca venturos differs sed mentis in annos: Estque minùs morbus quàm medicina grauis.
Næ s in formoso deformis corpore,rectòr Infirmus firmæ dicitur esse ratis.
Radices imis penitus convellito fibris Arboris,euulsam quam semel esse cupis.
Errores cæco de pectore tollere si vis, Radices imâ vellere mente studè.

head.i: Cera manu tractata. Mens exercita labore ad virtutem recipiendam aptior.

main_text.p: Ni tractata manu & tepido mollita calore, Non valet impositos carpere cera typos: Sit vario furerit nisi mens excita labore, Virtutis nescit sumere dura modum.
Seditione domus quantumuis corruit ingens; Discordi pereunt maxima regna lue:

page.notes: The bottom of the page carries a mirrored show-through inscription, not transcribed. Several words in the verse are uncertain due to damage and ink bleed (e.g., "Pharmaca", "Sit vario", "Enerua" in the right margin is a partial marginal word). Decorative marginal woodcuts are not text.
